 Hoang Dung acts as a bridge at the Korean-Vietnamese cultural exchange event; QWER is moved by the fans.
 HHTO - Amidst the influx of idol groups to Vietnam in recent years, the concert at the 2026 Korean Cultural Road Festival stands out by bringing together bands that are popular in Korea. Hoang Dung, representing Vietnamese artists, becomes an interesting cultural bridge.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 27/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 The K-Liveband Festival is part of the 2026 Korean Cultural Road Festival, organized by the Korean Embassy in collaboration with the Korean Cultural Center in Hanoi. The event offers a space for Vietnamese-Korean cultural exchange with many exciting activities. 
 Photo: Ha Trang The K-Liveband Festival brought together Korean bands such as QWER, Silica Gel, Touched, and others, offering a diverse range of musical styles. Electric guitars, powerful drum beats, and energetic performances energized the stage, creating a vibrant live music experience for the audience.
 Notably, QWER was one of the standout names at the October 24th show. Debuting in 2023, the four-member girl group Chodan, Magenta, Hina, and Siyeon became a K-Pop phenomenon thanks to their bright, energetic music reminiscent of anime soundtracks.
 The concert in Hanoi was made even more special for QWER when Vietnamese fans organized a birthday celebration for Chodan. Touched by the thoughtful preparations of the Vietnamese Bawige fans, the female artist expressed her gratitude for their affection. 
 You may also like QWER brought their hit song TBH to Vietnam for a performance. - Video: TikTok @kim_jiwoo99 Besides QWER, Silica Gel and Touched also offer their own unique styles, from experimental sounds to powerful melodies. - Photo: Ha Trang Photo: Ha Trang Although not a member of the band, Hoang Dung appeared with Mau Nuoc Band. The moment he appeared amidst the cheers of the large audience, it showed his appeal and suitability for the lineup of the Vietnam-Korea cultural exchange music festival.
 Hoang Dung chose to open with Phonecert (10CM). Vietnamese lyrics and Say My Name (Speak softly to me) . This is the first time he has presented a live version of Say My Name - a song in collaboration with Dept - to the audience. This choice is considered smart, as both songs are collaborations between him and Korean artists, creating a connection with the spirit of cultural exchange. 
 You may also like Photo: Ha Trang The audience sang along with Hoang Dung in "The Muse". - Clip: Ha Trang Hoang Dung's performance brought fans back to memories of his previous concerts, such as "Spinning Around ," "One Day," "Keep Him for Yesterday," and "Muse," taking the audience through various emotional stages, with every song accompanied by enthusiastic fan chants. To conclude his performance, Hoang Dung chose "Champagne," a cheerful and lively tune.
 Young people and tourists participating in the event highly appreciated the organization of the 2026 Cultural Road Festival . After five years of organization, the scale of the music night has gradually expanded, increasing audience expectations that more prestigious names from the Korean and Vietnamese music scenes will be invited to participate each year.
